status: bounded experimental policy, not accepted production hierarchy
heightPolicy: Preserve Copernicus EGM2008 and Swiss LN02. No vertical or horizontal correction. The composite is explicitly heterogeneous.

candidateStrategies.common: Common-only control; original tiles through z13, explicitly resampled common signal above z13.
candidateStrategies.H0: Use exact Swiss delivery tile where present at that requested DEM level; common otherwise.
candidateStrategies.H1: Use common below requested DEM z14; exact supported Swiss tiles at z14-18; common otherwise.

gateBasis: Fixed discovery cameras: little change at landscape/planning; obvious additional channels/ledges at camera 13.2 and increasingly close views. Gate is conservative for the bounded test, not an optimum or universal camera threshold. Geometry and relief request different DEM levels; actual requests are recorded.
supportPolicy: Whole supported Swiss delivery tiles at each level; no rectangle-centre decision, no invented partial coverage. Explicit Copernicus fallback within its finite two-root context.
protectedInterior: When Swiss tiles are selected, retain exact original PNG heights. Coarse common representation is not claimed to preserve Swiss point heights.
composition: Pure tile labels only: 0 Copernicus EGM2008, 1 swissALTI3D LN02. No mixed-weight cells, no confidence interpretation.
deferred: No feather, fitted offset, transformed Swiss, derived collar, seamline or generic resolver. Spatial transition support remains unresolved.
